about: Home's painting as a place Lumi can walk: the floor she may stand on, the furniture she passes behind, and the tour she walks. Painting pixels of art/scenery/home/background.png (1536x1024). Measured by eye on 2x zooms (2026-09-13) for the walk test; a proposal, not a map of the room.

iso.note: the rug's and table's edges run at ~0.57 px down per px across; ground (u, v) come from screen (x, y) with this slope

lumi.note: hood top to feet in painting px at every depth (isometric: no perspective scale); the table top stands ~65px, a floor cushion ~60px

occluders.note: the low table with the books, lantern, plant, small stack and mug on it; the cut-out is drawn over her whenever she is behind its footprint
the cream floor cushion with tassels

tour_note: Placed in ground coordinates round the furniture's footprints (u, v from the iso slope), a little outside the walking clearance: right of the green cushion; behind the table's back-right edge, its back corner and its back-left edge; in front of the cream cushion; in front of the green one.
